Togedemaru

Electric Steel

Alola · Generation 7

Togedemaru is an Electric/Steel-type Roly-Poly Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 3.3 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Attack (98), with a base stat total of 435.
